task.description: Implement ISS-0534: log the discarded JIT-provisioning failure reason in AuthPipeline's handle_auth_error/2, single-clause fix.

result.note: Added require Logger to auth_pipeline.ex (previously absent, confirmed by grep). In the {:error, {:provision, reason}} clause (renamed from _reason), added Logger.error("JIT user provisioning failed reason=#{inspect(reason)}") before the existing reject(conn, 500, ...) call. No manual trace_id threading (auto-attached by Letflow.Obs.Logger's formatter from Logger.metadata()). Nothing else touched: OQ-9's settled 500-classification decision, req021-auth-plug-pipeline.md, and the Keycloak-volume-reset doc note all explicitly left alone. New regression test added in test/letflow/plugs/auth_pipeline_configurable_verifier_test.exs (no existing test asserted on this path at all): pre-seeds a User row under a different external identity but the same username the incoming token maps to, deterministically triggering the real (non-race) username-collision path, wraps the call in ExUnit.CaptureLog.capture_log/1, asserts the response is still an unchanged 500/internal_error body AND the log now contains the inspected changeset reason. Real test output: mix test test/letflow/plugs/auth_pipeline_test.exs test/letflow/plugs/auth_pipeline_configurable_verifier_test.exs -- 14 passed. mix compile --warnings-as-errors clean; mix format --check-formatted clean. mix test test/letflow/plugs/ showed 109/114 passed, 5 failures in admission_pipeline_test.exs (versions_missing=[20260907020001], a pre-existing tenant-fixture/migration environment issue) -- independently verified pre-existing via git stash + re-run on the unmodified branch, same 5 failures present, confirmed unrelated to this change. SECURITY-REVIEWER dispatch warranted: this touches lib/letflow/plugs/auth_pipeline.ex, squarely on the authentication/tenant-boundary path.
